comment: libdaas required by daasiot-android: the packages of the public catalog https://daasiot.com/api/libdaas.php (the only source of libdaas), one per <target>/<linkage>, with the file name of the catalog (tarball) and its SHA-256. tools/fetch_ld/fetch_ld.sh installs exactly these packages into libdaas/<target>/<linkage>/. Edit this file to add a package or to move to another libdaas version (every tarball of the same version); fetch_ld.sh --verify checks the names and prints the published SHA-256 to write here. Android packages are static only.
